name: menu-surface
description: The menu surface: one panel recipe and one row recipe, shared by Menu and ContextMenu. Not two components that happen to look alike — Base UI's ContextMenu re-exports Menu's Item, Group, Separator and Submenu verbatim, so they are literally the same rows in the same popup, differing only in what opens them. A recipe rather than a component for the same reason chrome-control is: it styles, it does not wrap, so the behaviour layer keeps ownership of roles, roving focus, typeahead and dismissal.
